headline: Parliament: Draft state budget to be submitted tomorrow - What it will say about growth
summary: The draft state budget for 2027 is expected to be submitted to Parliament on Monday, 5 October 2026. The draft is described as shaping the outlook for growth.
why: The state budget sets Greece's tax, spending and deficit targets, which shape fiscal policy, government bond supply and investor sentiment on the euro-area periphery.
